name: kaaloo-agent-mods
description: Root manifest for the kaaloo/agent-mods monorepo. Hosts the secret-scanning and dependency-scan pre-commit/pre-push hooks; per-package manifests live under packages/*. The letta manifest below defines what a git-source install (letta install git:github.com/kaaloo/agent-mods) loads: mod entries may point into packages/* subdirectories.
